purpose: Models research classification, compartmentalization, protected records, controlled dissemination, compromise, and declassification as real information-access policy. It never changes scientific truth, creates magic invisibility, or takes ownership of espionage/security actions from their owning workstreams.

access_classes.name: Normal Scientific Access
access_classes.meaning: Ordinary authorized scientific institutions/contexts within the polity can receive the codified result through normal dissemination rules.

access_classes.name: Restricted Program
access_classes.meaning: Only explicitly eligible institutions, roles, contexts, or collaborating parties receive detailed records; normal polity-wide dissemination is withheld.

access_classes.name: Classified
access_classes.meaning: Detailed records require explicit security authorization and protected storage/communications under owning security-policy rules.

access_classes.name: Special-Access Compartment
access_classes.meaning: Detailed records are split into need-to-know compartments. Possessing one compartment does not imply access to all project records or implementation details.

existence_disclosure_states.meaning: The program/knowledge record may be known to exist even when details are restricted.
Existence/metadata is disclosed only to authorized internal roles/contexts; unauthorized observers may still infer it from physical evidence.
Owning policy attempts to conceal the program/record's existence from unauthorized parties. This is an intent/access policy, not guaranteed invisibility.

record_scope.rule: Apply security only to records/assets that materially need different access. Do not create one classification row for every normal research node.

external_release_policy.meaning: No deliberate external release; external parties can still learn through legitimate observation, sharing agreements, leaks, capture, or intelligence.
High-level existence/capability/scientific summary may be intentionally released without actionable implementation records.
Selected codified theory/data may be externally published or shared; engineering/tacit assets remain separately controlled.
A deliberate external package may include engineering records/assets according to technology-exchange rights and technical availability.

compartment_model.rule: Compartments divide actual records/responsibilities. They do not split the underlying scientific truth into contradictory universes.
compartment_model.cross_compartment_integration: Engineering stages may require an authorized integration context that can access the necessary compartments. Missing access is a concrete participation/blocker condition, not a generic RP penalty.
compartment_model.minimum_information_rule: A compartment should exist only when there is genuinely separable information/need-to-know value; do not create decorative compartments.

actual_effects: only authorized Effective Research Labs can be assigned
restricted cross-institution review can reduce evidence/reproducibility readiness only when the project genuinely requires independent validation
extra physical replication sites/archives must actually be built/maintained if security policy requires redundancy
communications security or compartment boundaries may delay specific coordination/data dependencies when external systems report them as material
research_project_effects.rule: If secrecy makes a project slower, the slowdown must be explainable through reduced real eligible capacity, missing validation, communications/security constraints, or duplicated physical work—not an arbitrary secrecy multiplier.

protection_inputs_owned_elsewhere.rule: Adaptive Research consumes factual service availability/limitations. It does not simulate spy actions, security personnel, cryptographic attacks, infiltration, interception, or counterintelligence operations.

research_effects: create/update evidence with provenance when actual records/observations are acquired
create/update foreign-technology assessment when another polity's implementation becomes known
add tacit/record assets only for what was actually compromised
never directly set the recipient's native node Mature
never tell the owner who has the data unless detection/intelligence legitimately established that fact
compromise_model.partial_compromise_rule: Engineering blueprints without tooling/experts can improve understanding/reproduction assessment but do not imply native practical reproduction.

observation_vs_records.rule: Physical observation of a classified deployed capability follows the existing legitimate_foreign_capability_observed path.
observation_vs_records.possible_result: An observer can know that a capability exists or characterize performance while remaining ignorant of the source node, theory, manufacturing process, or complete design.
observation_vs_records.secrecy_limit: A classification policy cannot suppress photons, debris, combat telemetry, emissions, trade effects, or other real observables. Other systems decide what can actually be sensed.

declassification_and_reclassification.declassification_rule: Changing access policy expands authorized dissemination/archives. It does not change research maturity, retroactively create expert practice, or automatically export knowledge to foreign polities.
declassification_and_reclassification.reclassification_rule: Tightening policy stops future normal dissemination and can restrict access to protected records, but cannot erase copies already lawfully/physically distributed unless real deletion/recovery actions occur.
declassification_and_reclassification.compromise_persistence: Reclassification cannot un-leak records already outside control.
declassification_and_reclassification.archive_rule: Declassification can improve resilience by increasing independent codified copies; classification can reduce resilience if too few protected copies actually exist.

rules: classification creates access exceptions only where policy differs from synchronized default
classified records can remain confined to selected research contexts even when communications paths exist
authorized contexts still obey real communications latency
reclassification does not delete existing context copies; real deletion or recovery actions are required
political fracture inherits classified knowledge only where protected records/assets/authorized people physically or administratively fall under successor control
a successor may know a classified program existed without inheriting actionable records

technology_exchange_interface.rule: Deliberate sharing of protected knowledge uses the existing package/right model. Classification policy may restrict authorization to share, but it does not alter whether a copied record is technically copyable once acquired.

view_and_explanation.unauthorized_or_foreign_view: Shows only legitimately known metadata, observed capabilities, rumors/evidence, or acquired assets. Never reveal classification records just because they exist authoritatively.

cross_workstream_ownership.adaptive_research: research record classification semantics, authorized research participation, dissemination consequences, research-side compromise interpretation, declassification/reclassification effects
cross_workstream_ownership.intelligence_security: espionage, infiltration, interception, theft, defection, compromise detection, counterintelligence, personnel/facility security actions
cross_workstream_ownership.communications: actual secure path, latency, bandwidth, interception surface, authentication/confidentiality services
cross_workstream_ownership.governance: who may set classification policy and political/legal consequences of leaks
cross_workstream_ownership.diplomacy_trade: authorized external sharing/license negotiations and consequences
cross_workstream_ownership.construction_population: physical secure archives/facilities and expert cohort location/control
